title: Plum is Not Plum- color is Burgundy
text: Plum is Not Plum- color is Burgundy. The curtains are nice they look more of a rustic feel and texture than modern. Im sending them back only because I ordered plum but the color of the curtains are not plum at all they are burgundy.
